Premier Culinary Arts and Hospitality Management School

The Kendall College of Culinary Arts and Hospitality Management at National Louis University is the Chicago Michelin Guide Restaurants No. 1 ranked program in Chicago* for preparing students for careers in these fields. We combine a strong academic foundation with transformative practical experience, so our students are ready to hit the ground running when they embark on their chosen careers. The culinary arts and baking and pastry associate programs are accredited by the American Culinary Federation Education Foundation accreditation commission.
